reasons.text: The legible label photo shows model 2G805, which is not a recalled model. Under the claim policy the label is the evidence, so the claimed product is not covered by the recall, even though the typed model 2G520 is recalled.
The purchase is from a listed retailer (Esrtech.com) within the sale window, and no duplicate claims were found, but these checks do not cure the model mismatch.
The destruction photo shows the product marked RECALLED as required, but eligibility fails on the model.
